name: Koltira Deathweaver
summary: Koltira Deathweaver was a valiant high elf defender of Quel'Thalas who fell defending his homeland against the Scourge during the Third War. Raised into undeath by the Lich King's servants, he was transformed into an undead death knight bound in iron servitude to the Scourge.

sections.title: Fall of Quel'Thalas
sections.body: In life, Koltira stood among the proud defenders of the high elven kingdom of Quel'Thalas. When Prince Arthas Menethil marched the Scourge north to reach the Sunwell during the Third War, Koltira and his kin fought desperately against overwhelming waves of undead monstrosities. Defending his homeland alongside his brother Faltora, Koltira faced the Scourge death knight Thassarian in combat. Koltira was ultimately defeated and slain when the elfgates fell and the Scourge overran the realm.

sections.title: A Bound Death Knight
sections.body: Following his death, Koltira was raised as an undead death knight under the absolute command of the Lich King. Stripped of his living allegiance, he became bound to the will of the Frozen Throne. Strangely, a bond formed between Koltira and Thassarian—the man who had struck him down—with the two regarding each other as brothers in undeath while serving within the dark ranks of the Scourge.

faq.answer: Koltira is a high elven defender who was killed during the Scourge invasion of Quel'Thalas in the Third War and subsequently raised as a death knight under the control of the Lich King.
He was killed in single combat by the Scourge death knight Thassarian during the assault on Quel'Thalas after the kingdom's enchanted elfgates were breached.

faq.q: What is Koltira's connection to Thassarian?
faq.answer: Though Thassarian took Koltira's life in Silvermoon, Koltira felt internal conflict within the human death knight. Once Koltira was reanimated by the Scourge, the two warriors formed an unusual brotherly bond while serving the Lich King.

faq.q: Which faction does Koltira serve right now?
faq.answer: At this time, Koltira remains under the dominion of the Lich King, serving as an undead death knight bound to the Scourge.

angles.text: Forsaken who remember the fall of Quel'Thalas know all too well the horror of being murdered and bound into servitude by the Scourge.
Alliance veterans of the Third War remember the tragic collapse of Quel'Thalas and the terrible cost exacted by Prince Arthas.
